run_clang_tidy_check: run clang-tidy on specified source files to check for code issues
run_clang_tidy_fix: run clang-tidy with the --fix flag to automatically fix detected issues
run_clang_tidy_parallel: run clang-tidy on multiple files in parallel using the -j flag
run_clang_tidy_custom_binary: run clang-tidy using a custom binary set via the CLANG_TIDY environment variable
run_clang_tidy_with_config: run clang-tidy by explicitly passing the .clang-tidy config file contents
